name: BookForge Comprehensive Evaluation Set
description: Comprehensive eval set for every BookForge stage: intake, media, analyst, assets, writer, deterministic verifier, LLM critic gating, refiner, caches, compiler, orchestration, metrics and config. Network/LLM cases need YouTube access and EURI_API_KEY (from https://euron.one/euri); verifier/cache/critic-skip cases run without an LLM. Run with: adk eval bookforge eval/bookforge-comprehensive.evalset.json
